latency_claim.reason: negative or mixed paired p50 differences do not identify a positive gateway processing cost and are not evidence of a gateway speedup

headline.text: At 8 concurrent medium requests, the full gateway completed 60 measured requests per path with zero errors and observed 103.83% of direct-vLLM request throughput (paired-run range 101.37% to 108.94%). Paired p50 latency differences ranged from -1963.70 ms to -219.31 ms, so no positive gateway-added latency or speedup claim is made.
